name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan
summary: A solar energy scheme that provides subsidised standalone solar pumps and solarisation of existing agriculture pumps to farmers, giving reliable irrigation and an additional source of income.

eligibility_clauses.text: The applicant must be a farmer.

entitlement_rules.text: An eligible farmer receives a subsidy of up to Rs. 60000 towards the cost of a solar pump.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First grievance with the power distribution company.
Escalation to the state renewable energy agency.

appeal_hierarchy.authority: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
